🔥 chrome-crawler | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating complex web interactions, generating scripts for repetitive tasks, and creating 3D models directly within the Chrome browser using an AI agent.
✨ Key Features: • Web page interaction (reading, clicking, typing, scrolling) via Chrome DevTools Protocol • Support for both cloud and local LLM models • User confirmation for critical actions • Automated script generation for routine tasks
📖 Summary: Chrome Crawler is a JavaScript-based Chrome extension that acts as an AI agent within the browser's side panel. It can automate web interactions like reading pages, clicking, typing, and scrolling using the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It also supports generating scripts for routine tasks and creating 3D models via APIs.
